name: kaishare
description: KaiShare: surplus food rescue PWA (React + Vite client, Express + MongoDB API)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.preview: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
